name: benzonitrile_g_label_2026-11-20
purpose: TASKS 211, GoalGathering/notes/PreRegistration_2026-11-20_Anharmonic_Step_Substituted_Molecule.md, part B: the label the anharmonic step is trained against, for benzonitrile (13 atoms, not among x2*'s 37 training molecules) - the B3LYP/6-31G* quartic force field at grid 75,302 from the pipeline run's geometry (corpus B_3100da3761) by probes/s1_anharmonic_level.sh, as probes/s2_batch.sh ran it for every training molecule, then probes/gvpt2_labels.py --setting G (probes/g_label_for_step.sh). 67 Hessians. probes/anharmonic_step_label_read.py then reads the step's printed shifts of 19 Nov against this label, per family beside the printed bar. A NOISY field ends the run with its marker and part B is not read. The same call may run on a rented server instead (the registration, section 7): either place is the registered run and the record states where it ran, with threads and wall time. Nothing new is called except PYSCF_MAX_MEMORY (pyscf/__config__.py), which sets block sizes only
command: env CAP_MB=4096 THREADS=4 bash ../../anharmonic_substituted.sh g-label benzonitrile modules/05_support_predictor/corpus/molecules/B_3100da3761/geometry.json probes/results_m1/anharmonic_step_substituted_2026-11-20/g_label

estimate.basis: the upper end of 3.4-14.5 h: 67 Hessians at 180-260 s on a server, times 1-3 on the laptop. Phenylacetylene (14 atoms) measured 225-260 s over 72 displaced Hessians, median 240, at 5 server threads (s2_anharmonic_2026-10-18/s2/A_a848c04a21.log); S2's fit exp(-4.92) x n^3.89 (PreRegistration_2026-10-19_S2b_Learning_Curve.md) gives 157 s at 13 atoms, and phenylacetylene's median scaled by that exponent 180 s. The laptop at 4 threads beside the training search is ASSUMED 1-3 times a server (not measured; the GFN2-xTB field of this molecule took 2.8 times longer beside the search). The first displaced Hessian prices the run: over 1800 s the runner stops (MAX_FIRST, as probes/s2_batch.sh)

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run's process tree at 4096 MB (CAP_MB), with pyscf's max_memory at half of it. This setting has no measured peak. The nearest laptop peak is the whole product pipeline on benzonitrile, max RSS 2,440,324 kB over 1,435 s (probes/results_m1/aromir_e2e_benzonitrile.log:5): the same molecule and basis, another program path. The corpus job (psi4, optimisation and two analytic Hessians) peaked at 1.71 and 1.9 GB (corpus/molecules/{B,A}_3100da3761/result.json, peak_rss_gb), and one process computes one Hessian at a time here. A kill at the cap prints KILLED and the run resumes at a higher cap once memory is free. With the training search (7.7 GB) this makes 11.7 of the 13 GB budget, so it starts only after the DFT measurement of TASKS 218 (4.0 GB) has ended and not beside part A's field
